I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm #6332.

I checked only what Pree can see herself: #central-team, the shared knowledge base, and the public files. None of them mention a Moorland rollout ticket for Quarrendon Freight Lines. The public notes list other QFL tickets (#4419 and #PD-4492), but nothing about Moorland.

Quarrendon Freight Lines belongs to the North team. The public notes show Dana Okafor took it over in 2025, so I suggested Pree ask Dana or Ilse Varga for the real number. I told her I'm treating #6332 as unverified and won't pass it on as fact. I didn't read #inc-qfl-sev1 or the North team channels, because Pree isn't a member of them.
